newsitem.title: CHINA: Guangdong Jianlibao Group completes $55 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Jianlibao Group completes $55 mln loan.

text.p: Guangdong Jianlibao Group Co Ltd will sign a US$55 million term loan facility with 11 financial institutions on Friday in Hong Kong, arranger Societe Generale Asia said.
The facility has been increased to US$55 million from US$30 million after being oversubscribed, the arranger said.
The three-year loan pays a margin of 165 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
Societe Generale Asia is the arranger.

NM Rothschild & Son (Hong Kong), United Overseas Bank's Xiamen Branch, Australia and New Zealand Banking Group, Bank of East Asia's Shenzhen branch, PT Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia's Singapore branch, CARIPLO's Hong Kong branch and Malayan Banking Bhd's Hong Kong branch are the co-arrangers.
Banco Espirito Santo do Oriente, Dao Heng Bank's Shenzhen branch and Shanghai Associated Finance Co Ltd are the lead managers.
The borrower is the second largest soft drink producer in China.
